options.label: Any%
options.rule: Complete the game as fast as possible.

subcategories.label: No Major Glitches
subcategories.rule: The usage of major glitches is prohibited. Banned glitches are detailed here in [this guide](https://www.speedrun.com/pop1/guide/m4j3u).

options.rule:
Complete the game as fast as possible, while also doing the following:
- Drink all potions (including damaging ones)
- Cause your shadow to drink the life extension potion on level 5 (it later merges with you and so counts as a potion you can "drink")
- Kill all guards and bosses
- Drop the skeleton on level 3 into a pit (so that the victory music would be heard)
